marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Wind east 35 knots diminishing to southeast 20 near noon and to
southeast 15 near midnight. Wind diminishing to light early Tuesday morning then
increasing to northeast 20 near noon Tuesday. Snow changing to scattered flurries this evening.
Visibility 1 mile or less in snow. Temperatures near plus 1. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Seas 2 to 3 metres subsiding to 1 to 2 early this afternoon and
to 1 or less this evening.<br/>
